note: Adapted from the original English description of Scheffrahn & Křeček 1999, where the species was established as Cryptotermes juliani n. sp.; type locality Las Avispas, Peravia Province, Dominican Republic (about 1000 m), known only from a single colony at the type locality, a montane forest species; the specific name honours the collector Ing. Julián de la Rosa Guzmán. Alates: 14 individuals (including 7 males) from 1 colony; soldiers: 6 individuals from 1 colony. The authors' comparison of the alates refers to the section on C. brevis.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Body brown. Frontal face pale brown, the vertex brown; darkest on the dark brown (sepia) wing scales and the dark brown sclerotized wing veins. Antennae, abdominal tergites and pronotum brown, only the posterior corners of the pronotum dark brown. Labrum very pale brown. Femora nearly white; tibiae and abdominal sternites yellowish brown. Head nearly oval. Cranial sutures distinct. Compound eyes large, nearly oval, the edge opposite the antennal socket and the ventral margin nearly straight. Ocelli small, oval, almost touching the compound eyes. Antennae 14—16-segmented, usually 15, the segment formula variable. Pronotum nearly square, distinctly narrower than the head across the compound eyes; anterior margin distinctly concave, the sides slightly convex or nearly parallel, the posterior margin almost straight. Radius extending from the suture to near the middle of the wing. Radial sector with 6—8 branches. Arolium present.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Measurements (14 individuals including 7 males, 1 colony, in mm, the morphotype in parentheses): head length including the labrum 1.23—1.32 (1.28±0.027, 1.26); head length to the postclypeus 0.98—1.01 (1.00±0.012); maximum head width across the compound eyes 1.00—1.03 (1.01±0.010, 1.00); compound eye diameter 0.34—0.36 (0.35±0.0060, 0.34); shortest distance from the compound eye to the posterior margin of the head 0.13—0.16 (0.15±0.0080, 0.15); ocellus diameter 0.11—0.13 (0.12±0.0088, 0.11); maximum pronotal length 0.65—0.70 (0.69±0.015, 0.69); maximum pronotal width 0.87—0.95 (0.89±0.027, 0.87); total body length with wings 10.93—11.64 (11.25±0.21, 11.50); total body length without wings 5.11—6.11 (5.56±0.28, 5.54); forewing length (from the suture) 8.95—9.51 (9.26±0.20, 9.37); maximum forewing width 2.18—2.31 (2.25±0.042, 2.24).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head, in dorsal view, almost black on the anterior two thirds with a shining iridescence, the posterior part purplish chestnut brown; in lateral view the anterior half of the head almost black, the posterior half rusty. Mandibles very dark chestnut brown. Anterior margin of the pronotum rusty, with a paler extension inwards, the periphery with rusty orange marginal hairs. Head, in dorsal view, nearly square, broadly rounded posteriorly, slightly constricted near the frontal margin. Anterior two thirds of the head capsule with weak, undulate rugae, but the surface texture shining. Frontal margin raised, relatively narrow, with a median notch; the boundary between the frontal margin and the vertex fine. Frontal face shallowly concave, almost smooth in the middle, ridge-like at the sides. Frontal face meeting the vertex face at nearly 90°. Labrum bluntly pointed. Frontal horns bluntly triangular, the base twice as wide as long, spreading laterally in dorsal view; in lateral view more prominent, hemispherical. Genal horns small rounded tubercles, much smaller than the frontal horns, completely concealed by the frontal horns in dorsal view, contiguous with them at the base. Mandibles stout, with a distinct swelling at the base, broadly sickle-shaped behind the swelling; moderately short, the apical quarter curved back, abruptly narrowed to a point near the apex; the mandibles conceal the labrum.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Measurements (6 individuals, 1 colony, in mm, holotype): head length to the tip of the mandibles 1.77—1.87 (1.83±0.039, 1.81); head length to the frontal horns 1.44—1.52 (1.47±0.029, 1.46); frontal margin width 1.24—1.32 (1.29±0.030, 1.32); outer span of the frontal horns 0.95—1.03 (1.00±0.030, 1.03); maximum head width 1.26—1.32 (1.28±0.027, 1.28); head height without the postmentum 0.92—1.01 (0.98±0.035, 1.00); maximum pronotal width 1.18—1.21 (1.20±0.012, 1.21); maximum pronotal length 0.82—0.87 (0.84±0.022, 0.87); left mandible length (apex to ventral articulation) 0.78—0.85 (0.82±0.024, 0.85); total body length 3.81—5.54 (4.87±0.64, 4.70).
